text: Sync takes forever and I lost two days of notes while offline on a flight.

Works fine on wifi but the second I lose signal it's useless. No real offline support.
Love the templates but it's too expensive for what a student needs.
Sync conflicts overwrote my essay draft. I keep a backup elsewhere now, which defeats the point.
Mobile editor lags badly on long pages. Typing has noticeable delay.
Steep learning curve, took me weeks to set up. But my real problem is it's unreliable offline.
